Buddha’s Relics of Piprahwa Stupa
Discovery: In 1898, British land manager W.C. Peppe discovered a stupa at Piprahwa, containing relics of Buddha and valuable artifacts.
Initial Distribution: A portion of the relics was given to the King of Siam (Thailand), Ceylon (Srilanka) and Burma (Myanmar), while the rest were sent to the Imperial Museum of Calcutta.
Peppe's Share: Peppe received a share of the treasures, which his family later took to Britain.
